theme_central: The absolute divine origin of the revelation and the unshakable integrity of the Messenger — eyewitness to the greatest signs of his Lord during the Night Journey.

branches.title: The Prophet's revelatory experience
branches.resume: Description of the Night Journey, vision of the angel Jibril in his real form, the greatest signs of the Lord.

children.t: Night Journey, vision of Jibril, the greatest signs of the Lord

branches.title: Refutation of the pagan goddesses
branches.resume: Al-Lat, al-'Uzza and Manat are but names invented by men.

children.t: Refutation of the pagan goddesses, mere human inventions

branches.title: Divine authority, intercession of the angels
branches.resume: No intercession by the angels without Allah's permission; creation testing whoever does good.

children.t: No intercession without Allah's permission, creation to test mankind

branches.title: Divine justice, individual responsibility
branches.resume: No one will bear another's burden; man obtains only the fruit of his own effort.

children.t: No one bears another's burden, man reaps the fruit of his own effort

branches.title: Divine blessings, ancient peoples
branches.resume: Allah makes laugh and weep, gives death and life; destruction of 'Ad, Thamud, Nuh, and the overturned cities.

children.t: Allah makes laugh and weep, gives death and life, creates the pairs
Destruction of 'Ad, Thamud, the people of Nuh, the overturned cities

branches.title: The Hour approaches, closing
branches.resume: Which of the blessings do you doubt? Astonishment at laughing rather than weeping; final command to prostrate.

children.t: The approaching Hour (al-azifa), none but Allah can unveil it
Astonishment at laughing rather than weeping upon hearing the Qur'an, final prostration
